# DSH Studio v0.7.4

This Windows desktop polish release removes the transient black console window
that could still appear when pressing Start. v0.7.3 fixed Harness composition
and external-browser handoff; v0.7.4 completes the native child-process launch
contract for supervised startup and managed installation.

## Added

- No new user-facing features. This patch is intentionally limited to the
  Windows console-flash regression.

## Changed and secured

- Harness composition preflight and supervised startup now share Windows
  `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`. Profile composition, loopback binding, process ownership
  and restart policy are unchanged.
- stdout and stderr remain redirected into the Studio activity log, so hiding
  the operating-system console does not hide progress or failure diagnostics.
- Managed Harness, npm and pnpm installation use the same no-console contract.
  First install, Environment Repair and package lifecycle stages stay observable
  without exposing a console host over the desktop UI.
- The desktop bridge remains Protocol 3. Harness stays pinned to
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8` and pnpm stays pinned to 11.7.0.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed a black CMD/console window flashing when Start was pressed on Windows.
- Fixed both the `--dump-config` preflight and the following `dsh web` launch
  being able to create a transient console; both now originate from the same
  hidden launcher command.
- Fixed npm lifecycle stages during first install or Repair being able to flash
  a console while preserving streamed logs, timeouts and process-tree cleanup.

## Install and update

Windows users should upgrade from v0.7.3. Existing profiles, plugins,
workspaces and sessions are preserved, and the managed Harness does not need to
be reinstalled for this fix.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates still require the Tauri
signature. Windows Authenticode and Apple Developer ID credentials remain
unconfigured, so OS publisher warnings are separate from this console fix.
